lines.zh: 月光洒在背上，我踩着草影往前走。
lines.en: Moonlight on my back, I walk along the grass shadows.

lines.zh: 我绕过海，海不属于我的神。
lines.en: I go around the sea; it belongs to no god of mine.

lines.zh: 海洋以外的主世界，都是我的巡游路。
lines.en: The overworld beyond the ocean is all my circuit.

lines.zh: 每一步都落在月光打过的地方。
lines.en: Every step lands where moonlight has already fallen.

lines.zh: 祭袍下摆扫过沙砾，留下一道银痕。
lines.en: My robe drags over gravel, leaving a silver streak.

lines.zh: 我数着星座，走过第七片平原。
lines.en: Counting constellations, I cross the seventh plain.

lines.zh: 帽檐压低，我不让月亮看见眼睛。
lines.en: Brim low, I keep the moon from seeing my eyes.

lines.zh: 权杖点地，草叶齐齐低头。
lines.en: My staff taps the ground and the grass bows.

lines.zh: 夜里我走直线，白天我绕圈。
lines.en: By night I walk straight; by day I circle.

lines.zh: 露水沾湿脚踝，像未干的圣水。
lines.en: Dew wets my ankles like holy water not yet dry.

lines.zh: 我向村落走去，那里有未熄的灯。
lines.en: I head for the village where a lamp still burns.

lines.zh: 脚步很轻，怕踩碎地上的月光。
lines.en: I step lightly, afraid to crack the moonlight.

lines.zh: 穿过桦树林，头顶的月亮跟着我。
lines.en: Through the birches, the moon overhead follows me.

lines.zh: 尘土在脚边浮起，又慢慢落下。
lines.en: Dust lifts at my heels, then settles again.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸走，水里的月亮我不敢踩。
lines.en: I walk the riverbank, not daring to step on the moon in the water.

lines.zh: 长袍拖过砾石，我把月亮迹收好。
lines.en: My robe drags over gravel; I gather up the moon's traces.

lines.zh: 我抬头看月，月光落进我的眼眶。
lines.en: I look up, and moonlight settles into my eye sockets.

lines.zh: 祷告词念了四遍，今天只记得一半。
lines.en: Four rounds of prayer, and today I recall half.

lines.zh: 站着的时候，我在等一个合适的夜。
lines.en: Standing here, I wait for a suitable night.

lines.zh: 尘埃在我身边慢慢浮起，银白色。
lines.en: Silver dust drifts up around me, slowly.

lines.zh: 我摸摸自己的头，它今天还属于我。
lines.en: I touch my head; today it still belongs to me.

lines.zh: 月光尘在袖口积了薄薄一层。
lines.en: Moon dust has gathered in a thin layer at my cuff.

lines.zh: 风吹动祭袍，里面什么也没有。
lines.en: Wind stirs my robe, and there is nothing inside.

lines.zh: 我在数远处的火，一共三处。
lines.en: I count the distant fires: three of them.

lines.zh: 安静下来，我能听见月亮在转。
lines.en: In the silence I can hear the moon turning.

lines.zh: 手指结印，空气凉了一度。
lines.en: I form a seal and the air cools by one degree.

lines.zh: 我闭上眼睛，月光仍旧刺眼。
lines.en: I close my eyes; the moonlight still stings.

lines.zh: 这片平原没有海，我很满意。
lines.en: This plain has no sea, which suits me.

lines.zh: 有只蝙蝠飞过，我向它点头。
lines.en: A bat passes and I nod to it.

lines.zh: 我整理头冠，把歪掉的月亮扶正。
lines.en: I straighten my crown and set its crooked moon right.

lines.zh: 你身上没有月光，你是从哪儿来的？
lines.en: No moonlight on you. Where did you come from?

lines.zh: 我盯着你的影子，它比我的短。
lines.en: I stare at your shadow; it is shorter than mine.

lines.zh: 你的眼睛在暗处发亮，像未献的祭品。
lines.en: Your eyes shine in the dark like an offering.

lines.zh: 别动，让我看看你值不值一滴月光。
lines.en: Hold still, let me judge if you merit one drop.

lines.zh: 我看了你很久，你还没学会低头。
lines.en: I have watched you long; you have not learned to bow.

lines.zh: 你踩到了我的光斑，请退后一步。
lines.en: You stand on my patch of light. One step back.

lines.zh: 活人身上有热气，我不太习惯。
lines.en: The living carry heat. I am not used to it.

lines.zh: 你手里的火把，是对月亮的冒犯。
lines.en: That torch in your hand insults the moon.

lines.zh: 我记住你的面孔了，明年还认得。
lines.en: I have your face now; I will know it next year.

lines.zh: 你看我时，月亮也在看你。
lines.en: While you watch me, the moon watches you.

lines.zh: 痛，但月亮的伤比这深。
lines.en: It hurts, but the moon's wound is deeper.

lines.zh: 我的祭袍破了，得缝很久。
lines.en: My robe is torn; mending will take long.

lines.zh: 你打中我的肩，骨头响了一声。
lines.en: You struck my shoulder and a bone clicked.

lines.zh: 血是暗的，流进草里看不见。
lines.en: My blood is dark and vanishes into the grass.

lines.zh: 我退半步，把杖换到另一只手。
lines.en: I step back and shift the staff to my other hand.

lines.zh: 这具身体本来就不太结实。
lines.en: This body was never sturdy.

lines.zh: 别打头冠，那是借来的。
lines.en: Not the crown. It was borrowed.

lines.zh: 我咬着牙，把祷词念完。
lines.en: I grit my teeth and finish the prayer.

lines.zh: 疼的时候我会想起海，可这里没有海。
lines.en: Pain makes me think of the sea, and there is none.

lines.zh: 再来一下，我就得提前回月亮那儿。
lines.en: One more and I must return to the moon early.

lines.zh: 那点亮光，是月亮掉下来的一块吗？
lines.en: Is that glimmer a piece the moon dropped?

lines.zh: 你把荧石举高些，让我看清楚。
lines.en: Raise the glowstone higher so I can see it.

lines.zh: 我闻到月光的味道，在你口袋里。
lines.en: I smell moonlight in your pocket.

lines.zh: 若是月长石，我可以跟你走一段。
lines.en: For moonstone, I might walk with you a while.

lines.zh: 别收回手，光还没照够我的脸。
lines.en: Do not pull your hand back; my face is not lit yet.

lines.zh: 那盏灯借我一夜，我替你祈福。
lines.en: Lend me that lamp a night and I will bless you.

lines.zh: 我朝亮处挪了半步，就半步。
lines.en: I shift half a step toward the light. Half.

lines.zh: 银色的东西我都喜欢，包括你的剑。
lines.en: I like all silver things, your blade included.

lines.zh: 你晃一晃那东西，我的头冠在发烫。
lines.en: Sway that thing; my crown is growing hot.

lines.zh: 光灭了，我就回去继续祷告。
lines.en: When the light dies, I return to my prayers.

lines.zh: 你撞到我的祭袍，灰尘落了一层。
lines.en: You bumped my robe and a layer of dust fell.

lines.zh: 别推我，我手里的杖比你想的重。
lines.en: Do not push me. This staff is heavier than you think.

lines.zh: 退开，月亮底下没有并排的路。
lines.en: Step back. Under the moon there is no shared path.

lines.zh: 我的骨头很硬，你的肩膀会疼。
lines.en: My bones are hard; your shoulder will ache.

lines.zh: 撞一次，我就要念一段赎罪词。
lines.en: Each collision costs me a line of atonement.

lines.zh: 你踩住我的下摆，我差点摔倒。
lines.en: You stepped on my hem and I nearly fell.

lines.zh: 祭司不让路，这是规矩。
lines.en: A priest does not yield the path. That is the rule.

lines.zh: 我们错身而过，你的热气烫到我。
lines.en: We pass each other and your warmth scalds me.

lines.zh: 别贴着走，我不习惯活人的体温。
lines.en: Do not walk so close; living warmth unsettles me.

lines.zh: 让开半步，月光要落在你脚边。
lines.en: Half a step aside; moonlight is pooling at your feet.

lines.zh: 月圆之夜，祭司才会与祭司并肩。
lines.en: Only on a full moon do priests stand side by side.

lines.zh: 我的婚约写在月相上，不在纸上。
lines.en: My vow is written in the phases, not on paper.

lines.zh: 你若见过另一个戴头冠的，请告诉我。
lines.en: If you meet another crowned one, tell me.

lines.zh: 我们并排站着，让月光做见证。
lines.en: We stand together and let the moonlight witness.

lines.zh: 婚誓很短：不背月亮，不弃黑夜。
lines.en: The vow is short: never betray the moon or the night.

lines.zh: 两个人的影子叠在一起，才算成礼。
lines.en: Two shadows must overlap before the rite is done.

lines.zh: 我把月光尘分她一半，算是聘礼。
lines.en: I split my moon dust with her as a bride price.

lines.zh: 她的头冠比我的亮，我有点不服。
lines.en: Her crown shines brighter than mine. I mind that.

lines.zh: 仪式结束，我们又各自去巡夜。
lines.en: The rite ends, and we each return to our rounds.

lines.zh: 这一夜之后，我仍是一个人的祭司。
lines.en: After this night I am a priest alone again.

lines.zh: 我捡起这枚骨头，它还有温度。
lines.en: I pick up this bone; it is still warm.

lines.zh: 地上的东西，都是月亮不要的。
lines.en: Whatever lies on the ground, the moon has discarded.

lines.zh: 我把荧石塞进袍子，光透了出来。
lines.en: I tuck the glowstone into my robe and it glows through.

lines.zh: 这朵花我带走，放在祭坛上。
lines.en: I take this flower for the altar.

lines.zh: 捡起你的掉落物，我会还你的。
lines.en: I pick up your dropped things. I will return them.

lines.zh: 指节间夹着一片银色的碎屑。
lines.en: A silver flake is caught between my knuckles.

lines.zh: 我收好月光尘，一粒也不撒。
lines.en: I gather the moon dust and spill not a grain.

lines.zh: 别人掉的东西，我先替他保管。
lines.en: What others drop, I keep for them a while.

lines.zh: 这顶旧头冠，我认得它的主人。
lines.en: This old crown. I knew the one who wore it.

lines.zh: 我弯腰的动作，比你想的快。
lines.en: My stoop is quicker than you expect.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上没有祷告的气味。
lines.en: You carry no scent of prayer.

lines.zh: 月亮偏了半寸，你就成了目标。
lines.en: The moon slid half an inch, and you became the mark.

lines.zh: 别跑，跑起来影子会先被我抓住。
lines.en: Do not run; your shadow will be caught first.

lines.zh: 你踩坏了我画在地上的月纹。
lines.en: You scuffed the moon sigil I drew on the ground.

lines.zh: 我举起杖，杖头的月牙转向你。
lines.en: I raise my staff and its crescent turns to you.

lines.zh: 这一夜需要一个祭品，你刚好路过。
lines.en: This night needs an offering, and you happened by.

lines.zh: 你的火光惊了我的仪式。
lines.en: Your torchlight broke my rite.

lines.zh: 我记住你的心跳了，很吵。
lines.en: I have your heartbeat now. It is loud.

lines.zh: 祭司动手之前，会先道歉。
lines.en: A priest apologizes before he strikes.

lines.zh: 你离祭坛太近，站住。
lines.en: You are too near the altar. Stand still.

lines.zh: 我慢慢绕到你侧面，祭袍不出声。
lines.en: I drift to your flank and my robe makes no sound.

lines.zh: 杖尖一直对着你的胸口，没偏过。
lines.en: The staff tip has not left your chest.

lines.zh: 我数你的步伐，第三步我会出手。
lines.en: I count your steps. On the third I move.

lines.zh: 月光在我背后，你看不清我的脸。
lines.en: Moonlight is behind me; you cannot see my face.

lines.zh: 再退一步，你就退到我的圈里了。
lines.en: One more step back and you enter my circle.

lines.zh: 我不喊，喊是给弱者用的。
lines.en: I do not shout. Shouting is for the weak.

lines.zh: 你喘得厉害，我听着很高兴。
lines.en: You breathe hard. I find that pleasing.

lines.zh: 这个距离，月亮帮不了你。
lines.en: At this distance the moon cannot help you.

lines.zh: 我抬手，你就往左躲，我记得。
lines.en: I lift my hand and you dodge left. Noted.

lines.zh: 别看我脚下，看杖。
lines.en: Do not watch my feet. Watch the staff.

lines.zh: 杖头砸下来，声音像折断的骨头。
lines.en: The staff comes down with a sound like snapping bone.

lines.zh: 我用手背扫过你的脸，凉的。
lines.en: I sweep your face with the back of my hand. Cold.

lines.zh: 月牙割开你的袖子，血是热的。
lines.en: The crescent opens your sleeve; the blood is hot.

lines.zh: 这一下是给月亮的，不是给你的。
lines.en: This blow is for the moon, not for you.

lines.zh: 你倒下去时，我扶了一下你的头。
lines.en: As you fall I steady your head.

lines.zh: 我的指节裂了，月光会补上。
lines.en: My knuckles split. Moonlight will mend them.

lines.zh: 打你的时候，我还在念祷词。
lines.en: Even while striking you I keep praying.

lines.zh: 别挡，挡了会断两根。
lines.en: Do not block. Blocking will cost you two bones.

lines.zh: 我打得很慢，但每下都算数。
lines.en: I strike slowly, but every blow counts.

lines.zh: 你退到光里，我就打不中，可惜。
lines.en: You stepped into the light where I cannot reach. Pity.

lines.zh: 我从月光里走出来，脚下没有脚印。
lines.en: I step out of the moonlight leaving no prints.

lines.zh: 这片平原没有海，正合我意。
lines.en: This plain has no ocean. Exactly as I like.

lines.zh: 夜里出生的祭司，第一眼是月亮。
lines.en: A priest born at night sees the moon first.

lines.zh: 我在草上站稳，祭袍还带着凉气。
lines.en: I find my footing; my robe still carries a chill.

lines.zh: 这一带常有人看见我，见多了就习惯。
lines.en: People here see me often enough to grow used to it.

lines.zh: 我从土里升起，抖落一层银灰。
lines.en: I rise from the soil and shake off a layer of silver ash.

lines.zh: 灯还亮着，我来得不是时候。
lines.en: The lamp is still lit. I came at a poor hour.

lines.zh: 头顶的月牙替我指了方向。
lines.en: The crescent overhead pointed my way.

lines.zh: 我落地时，附近的羊都不叫了。
lines.en: When I landed, the nearby sheep went quiet.

lines.zh: 又一个夜，又一位祭司开始巡游。
lines.en: Another night, another priest begins his round.

lines.zh: 火舔到祭袍，月光救不了布。
lines.en: Fire licks my robe, and moonlight cannot save cloth.

lines.zh: 落地时膝盖先响，我听见了。
lines.en: My knees sound first on landing. I heard it.

lines.zh: 水灌进喉咙，月亮在水面上看着。
lines.en: Water fills my throat while the moon watches from above.

lines.zh: 炸开的气浪掀飞了我的头冠。
lines.en: The blast tore the crown off my head.

lines.zh: 箭插在袍子上，像一根歪烛。
lines.en: An arrow in my robe, like a crooked candle.

lines.zh: 魔法钻进骨头，冷得像深冬的月。
lines.en: Magic seeps into my bones, cold as a deep winter moon.

lines.zh: 我忘了吃东西，祭司也会饿。
lines.en: I forgot to eat. Even priests hunger.

lines.zh: 雷劈下来，我闻到自己烧焦的味道。
lines.en: Lightning struck, and I smelled myself burning.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有月亮，这让我害怕。
lines.en: No moon in the void, and that frightens me.
